thesis: Yasho exhibits exceptional price momentum and strong headline earnings growth following a heavy capex cycle. However, a parabolic 195% rally over 126 sessions leaves the stock severely overheated and trading well above consensus targets. Without detailed fundamental valuation metrics to justify the sharp multiple expansion, risk-reward is unfavorable for fresh positional long entries. A consolidation or mean-reversion pullback is warranted before initiating new positions.
risks: Sharp mean-reversion risk after a parabolic 195% 6-month rally
Execution and demand risks post-capex ramp-up
Valuation stretch trading well above analyst forecast targets
